thesis: Deploy the $30 cash into NVDA. Yahoo at 12:30Z says Nvidia supply is in place for AI demand growth; the same pre-open tape has the Nvidia CEO blessing Marvell and Marvell rising on an AI-switch launch. Skip GOOGL: Yahoo headlines an $80bn Alphabet equity raise and the stock falling, with Berkshire's $10bn stake only a partial offset. Do not add GLD (gold still hovering near $4,500) or more QQQ (Alphabet dilution cuts against the AI bid, and QQQ is already the largest line). Hold IWM; the pack has no small-cap catalyst. MRVL, NBIS, STM, SOFI, and CRDO are cited but have no open in the tape, so they are not ordered.
